Navy lightweight campus jacket open over off-white T-shirt, muted olive straight trousers, clean everyday sneakers, canvas backpack on one shoulder, one paw loosely holding smartphone at waist with screen facing inward. Confident relaxed stance. No financial symbols, no readable phone screen.
Focus on readable distinct faces, familial resemblance, age differences, tailored everyday clothing and natural fur. Restrained appealing stylization with sophisticated cinematic proportions, not photoreal wild animals, not plastic toys, not flat illustration. Enough space between figures so silhouettes and tails are distinct.
